_why: Three content validators each carried their own idea of which pages to look at, and every one was far narrower than the site: validate_above_fold and validate_cta_presence walked three directories non-recursively plus root synthesis-*.html (232 of 2,265 HTML files), and validate_extractability sampled the first 40 root files alphabetically. All three printed a generic 'OK (N checked pages)' that read as site-wide coverage. They now share scripts/lib/site_pages.js. This file is the ratchet that keeps them wide: each validator must examine at least min_pages_examined, and the floors here can only be raised. Lowering one is a visible diff with a reason, not a silent narrowing.
